FaqPage.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FaqPage.subtitle: Find quick answers to the most important questions about Autosolo.ch.
FaqPage.supportText: Our support team is happy to help. Contact us at any time!

items.question: What is Autosolo.ch?
items.answer: Autosolo.ch is a specialized online platform for private car sellers in Switzerland. sellers can easily list their vehicles and reach potential buyers directly.

items.question: Who can use Autosolo.ch?
items.answer: Autosolo.ch is designed for private individuals selling their own vehicles.

items.question: In which regions is Autosolo.ch available?
items.answer: Autosolo.ch is focused on the Swiss market. Listed vehicles must be located in Switzerland or the Principality of Liechtenstein.

items.question: Is Autosolo.ch also suitable for first-time sellers?
items.answer: Yes. Autosolo.ch is deliberately designed so that all sellers – regardless of experience – get the same fair opportunity.

items.question: How does Autosolo.ch differ from other platforms?
items.answer: We focus on fair prices, simple processes and personal support instead of complicated packages, anonymous hotlines or long-term commitments.

items.question: Which vehicles may be listed?
items.answer: Only roadworthy, correctly described vehicles that comply with applicable legal regulations may be listed.

items.question: Can several vehicles be listed at the same time?
items.answer: Yes. Sellers can list multiple vehicles – depending on the chosen package.

items.question: How long does a listing stay online?
items.answer: The duration depends on the booked package. Details can be found in the respective package description.

items.question: Can I edit my listing afterwards?
items.answer: Yes. Listings can be updated, adjusted or deactivated at any time.

items.question: Are listings checked?
items.answer: Yes. For quality assurance, we reserve the right to check listings randomly or ask questions if anything is unclear.

items.question: How much does it cost to use Autosolo.ch?
items.answer: Autosolo.ch offers clear, transparent and competitive prices – with no hidden fees.

items.question: Are there long-term contract commitments?
items.answer: No. Our packages are flexible and can be adjusted or terminated as needed.

items.question: Are there additional fees per vehicle sold?
items.answer: No. Autosolo.ch does not charge sales commissions.

items.question: Are price changes possible?
items.answer: Yes. Sellers can choose their plan if their needs change.

items.question: Will I receive an invoice?
items.answer: Yes. All payments are correctly documented and transparently billed.

items.question: How can I reach Autosolo.ch support?
items.answer: You can reach us directly and personally by phone or email – without waiting loops or anonymous ticket systems.

items.question: How does Autosolo.ch protect against fraud?
items.answer: We rely on technical protective measures, clear insertion rules and actively inform about safe buying and selling practices.

items.question: What should I do if I discover a suspicious listing?
items.answer: Please report the listing to us immediately. We will investigate the case quickly and carefully.

items.question: Is my data safe?
items.answer: Yes. Protecting your data is our top priority. All data is processed in accordance with applicable data protection regulations.

items.question: Are there additional security features for sellers?
items.answer: Yes. For sellers, we recommend, among other things, providing a mobile number for additional account security.

AboutPage.heroPlatform: Autosolo.ch is the platform for private car sellers in Switzerland.
AboutPage.missionText1: We developed Autosolo with a clear goal: to make vehicle sales simple, efficient and fair – without unnecessary administrative overhead, hidden costs or complicated processes.
AboutPage.missionText2: Especially in today's world, we know:
AboutPage.missionText3: Listing vehicles must be effective, not expensive. Time is limited, costs are rising – which makes a platform that thinks ahead, listens and supports all the more important.
AboutPage.humanTitle: More Than Technology – It's About People
AboutPage.humanText1: At Autosolo.ch, it's not just about technology, numbers or algorithms.
AboutPage.humanText2: It's about you, your vehicles and your customers.
AboutPage.humanText3: We listen, understand the challenges of daily seller journey and are personally available to you at all times. Friendly, respectful and solution-oriented.
AboutPage.reachableText1: At Autosolo.ch, you speak directly with us.
AboutPage.reachableText2: No anonymous support team. No bureaucratic maze.
AboutPage.reachableText3: You can simply pick up the phone or write to us – we listen, advise honestly and help quickly. Just as you would expect from a reliable partner.
AboutPage.pricingText1: We believe: Good visibility and efficient listings don't have to be expensive.
AboutPage.pricingText2: No hidden fees, no forced packages. You invest where it counts: in selling your vehicles.
AboutPage.whyText: Because we understand what car private sellers need today.
AboutPage.efficiencyDesc: simple handling, clear processes, targeted visibility
AboutPage.humanityDesc: personal contact, genuine interest, respectful interaction
AboutPage.whyAllSellers: All car private sellers are welcome here – no experience needed. Everyone is treated fairly and gets the same chance to present their vehicles optimally.
AboutPage.closingText1: Autosolo.ch makes selling simple, fair and human.
AboutPage.closingText2: We move with the times, listen and develop the platform together with sellers.
